pages.title: Bulletin ORSA-WX-12
pages.text: $(bold)FIELD MAINTENANCE BULLETIN$()$(br2)All monitoring stations receiving an ORSA ingest node are to continue manual instrument calibration even after remote lockout or communications degradation.$(br2)Ground-truth observations remain mission critical for correction modeling.

pages.title: Field Note
pages.text: The bulletin is written like a reminder to replace printer toner.$(br2)It never acknowledges that the stations were staffed by civilian meteorologists stranded in a dying world.$(br2)The wording assumes the data stream will outlive the people producing it.
